title: FBI Photo B12
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted text from the PDF is heavily garbled/corrupted, suggesting extensive redaction or OCR failure on a degraded image
No mission report accompanies this image, removing operational context
Single-source observation with no corroborating data provided
The displayed timestamp (12/31/99) is a known default date indicating unconfigured system clock, not the actual event date
The image was pre-redacted by the FBI before submission to AARO, meaning unknown information has been removed

verifiable_claims.claim: The displayed date of 12/31/99 is incorrect because the system date/time was not set
